name: Argonaut BBS
summary: Perth BBS + dialup + IRC + hosting (argo.net.au, 1996; 'argoDSL'); defunct (MCKAY, KENNETH (sole trader), ABN 27 302 904 533).

events.details: Defunct. Both current (by 2008) and proposal (by 2018) are wrong as death dates; dial-up retail verified Oct 2009, gone (redirected) by Jun 2018 — argo.net.au today 301s to https://jazi.net/. last live dial-up retail 30 Oct 2009; domain 301s to Key Internet by Jun 2018.
